description: BMX bikes have one purpose; to transfer every ounce of power in your legs to the ground. Whether you are pint-sized or full-sized like Haro’s Double A pro Warwick Stevenson, there is a Group 1 for you. Our aluminum hydro-formed SX models represent the state-of-the-art in frame engineering, blending incredible torsional stiffness with light weight.
